errors.text_span: 包括“程度”、“空间”、“时间”、“形态”、“数量”和“情状”
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly lists the categories on the x-axis. It hallucinates the categories "数量" (quantity) and "情状" (situation) and omits the actual categories "频数" (frequency), "情绪" (emotion), "状态" (state), "评价" (evaluation), and "性格" (personality).
The description claims the x-axis categories are sorted alphabetically, which is not true. There is no discernible order to the categories.
The y-axis range is from 0 to 250, not 0 to 210.
The y-axis does not have a unit named "评价" (evaluation). "评价" is a category on the x-axis. The y-axis represents a numerical count.
The y-axis major tick interval is 50, not 20. The ticks are at 0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250.
The chart contains nine bar plots, not six.

errors.text_span: 第二个柱状图代表“空间”，其高度约为13，数值标签为13
errors.evidence: The second bar represents "空间" (space), but its value is 112, not 13.

errors.text_span: 第四个柱状图代表“形态”，其高度约为20，数值标签为20
errors.evidence: The fourth bar represents "形态" (form), but its value is 74, not 20.

errors.text_span: 第五个柱状图代表“数量”，其高度约为146，数值标签为146
errors.evidence: The fifth bar represents "频数" (frequency) with a value of 13. The description incorrectly names it "数量" (quantity) and assigns it the value 146, which belongs to the seventh bar, "状态" (state).

errors.text_span: 第六个柱状图代表“情状”，其高度约为112，数值标签为112
errors.evidence: The sixth bar represents "情绪" (emotion) with a value of 20. The description incorrectly names it "情状" (situation) and assigns it the value 112, which belongs to the second bar, "空间" (space).
The description omits any mention of the last three bars in the chart: "状态" (state, value 146), "评价" (evaluation, value 210), and "性格" (personality, value 44).
